title: for 28 weeks i have been working on a WoW Classic + RTS type mmo game and need play testers!
author: Ok_Mission1899
selftext:
posted last time about 5 weeks ago and here with an update on my  mmorpg made in Godot + SpacetimeDB !

i had received a lot of controversy on my last post and took the advice seriously and did a major redesign on the UI and feel so it wasnt just a wow clone

now, players choose to revitalize up to three playable classes/races (only dwarf shown here) through a series of starter quest. you are able to seamlessly swap between any of your allies at any time and assume control of them!

to explore the world or use special abilities, you will enter an RTS camera point of view to discover and see the real map and where you could possibly reach!

the idea is you are an artificial intelligent robot programmed to ensure their safety and you will study and guide your three classes through a vast open world with other players, slowly watching them grow in strength with what you discover

fight challenging creatures who are smart enough to gather allies and fight in groups, and team up with others to fight wars or enemies where your three strength isnt enough

working to finalize a playable demo and currently in steam's review process, so expect in mid-october. gathering seriously interested people now

thanks everyone, its always supportive here and happy to answer any questions and curious of any feedback for those who have continued following the updates
